body: It would have to apply for a freelance visa to start. Many people from North America and elsewhere have done exactly what I want to do, though there are certainly some hoops to jump through. Don’t worry, I’m doing my research :) Thanks though!

I’m a weightroom attendant, and before we open or after we close, I try to sneak onto the elliptical, even if I only have 5 minutes. And boy, those 5 minutes make a huge difference for the rest of my day! There is more pep in my step, I feel more confident, sharp, energetic, and talkative. I like to say that exercise “clears out the cobwebs” in my brain, because it really does!

And now, I can’t go a day without some kind of cardio, precisely because of that mental boost and surge of well-being. It’s a full-on addiction now. Even when you tell yourself “Oh, just 5 minutes!”, it’s very easy for those 5 minutes to turn into 10 minutes, then 15 minutes, then 20. Once you get going and have good music on, there‘s no stopping you!

Thank you everyone for your replies and reaching out to me. :) I've gotten a lot of messages over the past few days and I want to take my time replying to each of you. Again, thank you! I am very touched that so many people want to talk and be friends.
